description: Adds the main subject of another of the user's photos (with_photo_id: an object or a person, a cutout works well) into one of their photos, keeping its scene, framing and light, paid from their credits. with_photo_id may not be a selfie, nor photo_id itself. Pass the price the user agreed to as max_credits: the photo's prices from get_shoot or list_photos name it. If a call to this tool got no answer, it may already have started: check list_photos before calling it again.
name: combine
title: Add to a photo from another photo
